types.description: Harmony XB4 white integral-LED light body with metal fixing collar, 230–240 VAC, 50/60 Hz; source 24 VAC/DC description conflicts

document.title: Schneider Electric ZB4BVM1 product data sheet
document.pages: 1 and 3; applicable manufacturer FAQ FA272320 circuit and NHA93116 bonding instruction are cited in modelingNotes

modelingNotes: SOURCE CONFLICT: source order ZB4-BVM1 is described as 24 VAC/DC, but exact Schneider ZB4BVM1 evidence from July/October 2019 and October 2021 specifies 230–240 VAC 50/60 Hz. This is an exact catalog-order model, not verification of the installed unit. Do not silently substitute ZB4BVB1 or alter wiring to resolve the conflict.

All alphanumeric characters in source ZB4-BVM1 match manufacturer ZB4BVM1; the source presentation hyphen is retained verbatim in orderNumber. Matching body/collar/white integral LED scope supports normalization; the conflicting voltage remains explicitly unresolved at installed-identity level.

Included assembly is the Zamak fixing collar plus white protected integral LED light block with two screw-clamp terminals. The external lens/head is separate: manufacturer October 2021 catalogue physical 68 / printed 66 gives XB4BVM1 = ZB4BVM1 + ZB4BV013. No contact blocks, test accessory or grounding plate are asserted included.

Exact 5 October 2019 sheet documents (X1-X2)PL. Applicable Schneider FAQ FA272320 https://www.se.com/fr/fr/faqs/FA272320/ expressly names ZB4BVM1 and its right-hand ZBZ-M156 drawing for ZBV-M blocks depicts the two X1/X2 lamp screws on AC rails. T terminals, test contacts and diode links belong to the separate optional test arrangement, not this base body.

Rated lamp supply range is 230–240 VAC at 50/60 Hz; supply limits 195–264 VAC are a separate operating range. Only AC type is scalar metadata: no arbitrary midpoint nominal_voltage or single frequency is invented. No DC rating, DC positive/negative polarity or fixed L/N assignment is established. X1/X2 remain the manufacturer terminal names.

One load function with the existing lamp symbol represents the light circuit. The input electronics, described by the manufacturer FAQ as including a coupling capacitor and diodes, are not fixed continuity. No fixed net links or extra test/PE/contact terminals are modeled.

Class I shock-protection classification and metal collar presence do not prove an upstream protective bond. No separate PE screw is identified on the base LED body. The collar fixing screw remains mechanical; no lamp terminal is joined to metalwork.

Protective bonding is an installation requirement to be established by the project. Separate accessory ZBZ110 is shown in manufacturer NHA93116 01, 06-2021: https://download.se.com/files?p_Doc_Ref=NHA93116&p_File_Name=NHA93116_01.pdf&p_enDocType=Instruction+sheet. For nonconducting or painted support, its ground terminal is to be connected to the grounding circuit. Mounting/bonding continuity is not modeled; coverage is partial.
X1 and X2 are required under library policy for the modeled operating lamp. Required endpoints do not establish voltage suitability, physical assembly or installed wiring correctness.

Exact historical sheet conditional details: 14 mA lamp consumption, 100,000 h stated life at rated voltage and 25 °C, 600 V insulation at pollution degree 3 and 6 kV impulse withstand; these are not contact switching ratings or nominal supply. Screw clamps and conductor/torque limits remain documentary.

connectionCoverage.notes: Both documented lamp field screws X1 and X2 are modeled; one load function, no fixed links. Exact assembly includes metal fixing collar and LED block. Installation-dependent collar/support/earthing interface and its protective continuity are not modeled or proven. Separate head, contact/test blocks and grounding plate are excluded; no PE screw or factory panel bond is invented. Source 24 VAC/DC versus manufacturer 230–240 VAC remains unresolved for the installed unit.

X1.description: Lamp supply terminal X1; 230–240 VAC across X1-X2, 50/60 Hz. No DC polarity or assigned L/N alias.

X2.description: Other lamp supply terminal X2; 230–240 VAC across X1-X2, 50/60 Hz. Distinct from X1; no DC polarity or assigned L/N alias.
